message: Canonical P0 flagship #2612 exact head 9e7c65cde7d33b731ea04e11cfe43a792743ed5d has the same selective-graft package blocker class while its standalone Capture Xcode build succeeds. The retained package artifact explicitly records stale failures in TuyaMetadataAccountUIDCustodySourceTests and TuyaMetadataSecretRedactionSourceTests demanding strategy["result"] / localStrategy after production intentionally removed that false provenance; immediately afterward Swift Testing itself aborts with Range requires lowerBound <= upperBound. Open PR #2799 exact ff70b15cd770fcfa11c37635ebf528fcf554fda0 is the existing two-test truth repair and removes those stale demands without restoring localStrategy. Its own selective-graft artifact no longer records those expectation failures, but the Swift Testing Range abort still occurs later, so #2799 is necessary but not sufficient. Treat the residual Range abort as a separate package-test-runtime/source-test defect requiring isolation; standalone app build remains green. PHYSICAL NO-GO unchanged.
